Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 46 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that the audio call recording of 
Company’s Analysts/Institutional Investors Meeting/Call held on July 30, 2026 to discuss 
the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the Quarter ended June 
30, 2026 is available on the Company’s website. 
 
The link to access the said audio recording is https://www.waaree.com/investor/schedule-
of-analysts/#outcome-of-investors-meet-audio-video-recordings- . 
 
Under the following tab :- Schedule of Analysts or Institutional Meet < Outcome of 
Investor Meet (Audio/Video Recordings) < Q1 2026 – 27.  
 
Kindly take the same on record
